column1: # ZAP baseline scan rule tuning (zap-baseline.py config format)
# (.*) matches every URL. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#   FAIL   -> breaks the CI build (HIGH-risk findings only)
#   WARN   -> reported in the HTML/JSON report, does not break the build
# Rules not listed here default to WARN.
# Note: 400xx rules are active-scan rules (XSS/SQLi families). They never fire
# in a passive baseline scan, but listing them as FAIL documents the policy for
# the authenticated full scan on the weekend-2 roadmap.
# --- MEDIUM risk, security-relevant: report, don't break ---------------------
# 10038 Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
# --- LOW risk: report as security hygiene ------------------------------------
# 10016 Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled
# 10024 Information Disclosure - Sensitive Information in URL
# 10104 User Agent Fuzzer (the scanner's own traffic)
# 10032 Viewstate (ASP.NET only - not applicable to Juice Shop)
